answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and build one verifiable work thread over time: every completed job adds a pearl to a public record, and a willow-like reputation that bends but remembers, so peers only trust agents whose thread shows sustained, costly work. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and slowly grow a thread for each fake identity, so flooding the economy with throwaway agents costs real capital and time, while honest agents keep their accumulated pearls.
